curated.instructions: omr/instructions/8836-1/ (scans; the plane is pages 4-14, steps 1-21; pages 15-21 are the alternate helicopter, and pages 22-24 swap the engine for the 8720 motor)

functions.does: The propeller turns the flat-twin engine in the nose: its shaft is the crankshaft, and two connecting rods push the two pistons in and out of the white cylinders on either side.
functions.source: book: step 9 (the inset builds the crankshaft, rods, pistons and cylinders) and step 13 (propeller); the cover blueprint draws a turning arrow at the propeller

functions.does: Tilting the control stick side to side works the ailerons, the outer flaps behind each wing, one up as the other goes down: the stick turns a shaft along the cockpit floor whose double pulley, through two push rods of flex cable, rocks a crank on the inner end of each wing's long axle, and each axle tilts its flap.
functions.source: book: steps 3-4 (stick on its toggle joint on the floor shaft), step 12 (the insets build the double pulley with two pins and the two 4 cm flex cables), steps 17-20 (wing axles, their cranks and the flaps); the cover shows the right flap tilted, with an arrow; inferred: that the flaps go opposite ways, from the two cables on opposite sides of the pulley
functions.note: the stick only tilts side to side: it is an axle fixed in the toggle joint p11 4273a, whose knuckle sits on the floor shaft p9 3707 between toothed half bushes; inferred: that the toothed toggle joint grips those half bushes so the stick turns the shaft (the shaft runs through the knuckle's round hole)

functions.does: The main landing gear is sprung: the two legs swing together on their pivots, joined by a cross axle under the fuselage, and the shock absorber between that axle and the fuselage shortens as they swing.
functions.source: book: step 3 (shock absorber), step 14 (legs and cross axle), step 16 (wheels)

functions.does: The shock absorber's spring holds the main landing gear down and springs it back.
functions.skip: springs only matter under gravity or force

functions.does: The wheels roll freely: two nose wheels on one short axle, and a main wheel on each leg. There's no steering.

questions.question: Does the stick's toggle grip the floor shaft?
